title: UFO observers suffered 'hair loss, nightmares, boils and radiation illness'
excerpt: UFO witnesses have suffered symptoms including hair loss, nightmares, boils and signs of radiation illness, according to official documents.
content:
UFO witnesses have suffered symptoms including hair loss, nightmares, boils and signs of radiation illness, according to official documents.

Have UFOs been causing harm to humans?

The latest batch of UFO files released by the Pentagon contain a report dating back to 2010 which suggests a number of "human observers" were struck down with a variety of ailments within 72 hours after seeing an "anomalous aerospace-related event".

The 38-page study is titled: "Anomalous acute and subacute field effects on human biological tissues" and it lists symptoms suffered by three "antennae engineers" who were previously "fit and active" before coming into contact with a mysterious event in the skies.

The document reads: "Several years ago three previous fit and active individuals experienced an anomalous ['irregular, incongruous and inconsistent with their domain'] aerospace-related event. Within 72 hours they suffered medical sighs and symptoms".

It went on to list ailments including skin redness, pins and needles, diarrhoea, hair loss, boils and heart palpitations as well as nightmares, insomnia and anxiety while two of the three also suffered photophobia - an extreme sensitivity to light - as well as stinging eyes and swollen eyelids.

One of the three is said to have developed signs of radiation illness as well as "malignant transformations" linked to cancer.

The study concluded the three had been "subjected to an accidental exposure ... to a broadband ultrahigh radiofrequency mixed radiation of RF (radio frequency), NIER (non-ionising electromagnetic radiation) and microwave radiation."

It adds the "three antennae engineers [were] subjected to an anomalous 'accident'" but gave few details about the incident that caused the symptoms despite going on to analyse whether "anomalous craft induced affects on humans are intended or not".

It comes after a UFO expert claims glowing orbs seen in the sky could be a "warp drive" used by alien space craft.

Professor Avi Loeb of Harvard University, who is a leading US astrophysicist who sits on the UAP Science Advisory Council, has given his thoughts on the balls of light often seen in reports relating to UAPs (unidentified anomalous phenomena) and claimed the orbs could be light from a transportation mechanism used by extraterrestrial beings.

During an appearance on NewsNation, he explained: "If they have a cargo transportation system between habitable planets within their planetary system, we might see flashes of light from the beamer of a light sail.

"Technology that we can imagine. We don’t have such a system as of yet, but they may have it. In addition, they may also use for transportation a warp drive.

"That’s a bubble of distorted space-time that allows one to carry a cargo at an arbitrary speed across interstellar distances ... "If a warp bubble passes through the Earth’s atmosphere, it would cause a disturbance and produce a glowing ball of air. "

He added: "In fact, there are reports in the Presidential Unsealing and Reporting System for UAP Encounters from the U.S. government, including excellent work by the All-Domain Anomaly Resolution Office (AARO) in the Pentagon, about orbs.

"These are mysterious glowing spheres that they appear to be seeing and the FBI and other government agencies are reporting about.

"It’s not at all clear what some of these orbs are. Some of them might be drones but others are definitely not drones. And so it’s a detective story for us to figure out what technology might be employed if these orbs came from outer space."
